Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

HOT HONEY GROUND BEEF BOWLS 🍯🌶️ all I have to say is this one’s viral for a reason. Here’s how I made mine! Ingredients: (makes 4 bowls) 1 1/2 lbs sweet potato (680 g) peeled, diced into ~1/4” cubes salt, pepper, cinnamon - to taste 1 lb 93/7 lean ground beef 1 tbsp tomato paste (16 g) 1 tbsp taco seasoning 2 cups 2% low fat cottage cheese (452 g) 4 small avocados (400 g) 4 tbsp hot honey (84 g) Instructions: 1. Preheat oven to 425F and line a half baking sheet with parchment. 2. Add diced sweet potatoes, lightly spray with cooking spray and season with salt, pepper and a little cinnamon. Bake for 30 minutes, flipping and seasoning again halfway. 3. While potatoes are baking, make the taco beef. Heat a frying pan on medium high, add ground beef and cook, breaking apart into small pieces until fully cooked (~5 min). Drain any excess liquid. 4. Add tomato paste, taco seasoning, a splash of water and cook for 1-2 more minutes, stirring everything together. Remove from heat. 5. Build your bowl with sweet potato, taco beef, cottage cheese and fresh avocado. Finish it off with a drizzle of hot honey and enjoy! ✨ For the full printable recipe + nutrition, search 🔍 “hot honey ground beef bowls” at myproteinpantry.com or link 🔗 in my bio! 🫶🏼 #highprotein #easyrecipes #healthyfood #healthylifestyle #healthyrecipes #hothoney #beef #sweetpotato #avocado

videos.caption: I have convinced myself to think that @Noah Kahan wrote this song for volunteers, shelter workers, fosters, rescue advocates - all of the above. All of us are constantly advocating for these dogs while comforting them, singing to them, loving them even though we’ve just met them. When the world seems to have forgotten them, we howl for them too. We become their voice, telling everyone that they are still here, still worthy, still ready for someone to love them, still waiting for their moon. A2078007 Olive Oyl just seems like a very special girl. She was petrified and shaking nonstop until I picked her up to cuddle her and then she just melted. She seriously could’ve stayed there all day long, and I would have let her if I had the time. She’s (somehow) not on the euthanasia list yet, but I haven’t been able to stop thinking about her so I’m posting her now in hopes to get some eyes on her and gauge some interest. She is so deserving and I see so much potential in her. Just because she’s an anxious pup doesn’t mean she’s broken or less deserving of love or doesn’t deserve the moon. I am proud to howl for her, sing to her and circle her. BARC Animal Shelter 3300 Carr St #dogsoftiktok #fosteringsaveslives #euthanasia #dogmom #rescue

honey chipotle chicken sandwiches ✨ i will be uploading a newer version of my bun recipe because i tweaked it a bit to make them even softer!  Ingredients  - 1.5 lbs boneless skinless chicken breast - 1 1/2 cups buttermilk  - 1/3 cup pickle juice - 1/4 cup hot sauce - 1 large egg - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder  - 1 1/2 tsp chipotle powder  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp mustard seed powder  - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - Salt and pepper to taste  Dredge - 1 1/2 cups all purpose flour  - 1/2 cup cornstarch  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder - 1 1/2 tsp onion powder - 1 tsp smoked paprika - 1 tsp chipotle powder - 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder  - 1 sazon packet (optional) - 1/2 tsp mustard powder - Salt and pepper to taste  - Drizzle of marinade  Honey chipotle sauce - 1/2 cup honey - 3 tbsp chipotle peppers, blended - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 tsp apple cider vinegar  - 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1/4 tsp smoked paprika  - Salt to taste Assembly - Brioche buns - Pickles - Ranch Instructions  - Cut/pound chicken into even sandwich-sized pieces and add to a large bowl. - Add butter milk, seasonings, 1 egg, pickle juice, hot sauce, and mix until well combined. Refrigerate for 3 hours minimum or overnight for best results. - Combine all dredge ingredients. Drizzle a little of the marinade into the flour and toss with spoon create those crispy, craggy pieces. - Remove chicken from the marinade and coat well in the dredge. Dip it back into the marinade, then into the dredge again, pressing the flour mixture firmly onto the chicken. Let the double-battered chicken rest for 10–12 minutes so the coating sticks. - Heat frying oil to 350°F. Fry chicken in batches until deeply golden and crispy and the center reaches 165°F. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. - For the honey chipotle sauce, add honey, blended chipotle peppers, butter, apple cider vinegar, garlic powder, smoked paprika and salt to a saucepan. Heat on low for 2–3 minutes, stirring until smooth and glossy. - Brush or drizzle the warm honey chipotle sauce over the freshly fried chicken. - Toast your brioche buns, add ranch, pickles, crispy honey chipotle chicken, and serve immediately.  • • • #recipe #recipeideas #chickenrecipe #sandwich

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice. Enjoy! 🤍

⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Recipe: Chicken Tenders • 1 lb chicken tenderloins • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional, adjust to spice) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 sazon packet • 1–2 cups buttermilk • ⅛ cup jalapeño or pickle juice • 3 cups all-purpose flour (season with same seasonings) Hot Honey Sauce • ½ cup buffalo sauce • ¼ cup honey • ⅛ cup hot sauce (optional) Pasta • 1 lb penne pasta • 2 tbsp unsalted butter • 2 garlic cloves, finely minced • ½ yellow onion, finely chopped • 1 ½ cups heavy cream • 1 tsp onion powder • 1 tsp garlic powder • 1 tsp seasoned salt • 1 tsp creole seasoning • 1 tsp cayenne pepper (optional) • 1 tsp all purpose seasoning • 1 tsp black pepper • Grated mozzarella • Grated Parmesan Instructions 1. Season chicken tenderloins add in buttermilk and jalapeño/pickle juice then marinate for at least 30 minutes to an hour.  2. Coat chicken in seasoned flour set aside on wire rack and rest for 10 minutes before frying. Fry at 350°F until golden brown and crispy. Set aside and let cool on a wire rack. 3. In a sauce pan, add 1 tbsp of unsalted butter, buffalo sauce, honey, and hot sauce and simmer until fully combined. Then toss chicken in the hot honey sauce. 4. In a skillet, melt butter and sauté garlic and onion until fragrant. Pour in heavy cream and stir in all seasonings. 5. Add mozzarella and Parmesan until melted and creamy, then toss in cooked pasta. 6. Top creamy pasta with hot honey chicken and extra sauce if desired and enjoy :) #hothoneychickenpasta #hothoney #chickenpasta #pasta #fypシ

Throwback to this Honey Garlic Lemon Pepper Chicken Thighs recipe. The full recipe is posted below and can also be found in my cookbook Let’s Get Into It! Check out my cookbook through the link in my bio. Notes: If you are doubling the recipe, do not add more lemon slices to the sauce as it will become too bitter. Ingredients: •4 bone-in Chicken Thighs •2 tsp Lemon Pepper Seasoning •2 tsp Garlic Powder •2 tsp Smoked Paprika •1 tsp Kosher Salt •1 tsp Black Pepper •1 tsp Onion Powder •3 tbsp Olive Oil Sauce •2 tbsp Unsalted Butter •¼ cup Honey •4 slices of Lemon •4 tsp minced garlic •1 tbsp freshly squeezed Lemon Juice •2 tsp Low-Sodium Soy Sauce Instructions: Prepare the Chicken 1. Clean and pat the thighs dry. In a small bowl, combine the lemon pepper seasoning, garlic powder, paprika, salt, black pepper, and onion powder. Stir in the olive oil to make a seasoning paste. Fully coat the thighs with the paste, spreading it underneath the thigh skin to flavor the meat. Transfer the chicken to a zip-top bag or a container with a lid. Let the thighs marinate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight. 2. When the chicken is done marinating, preheat the oven to 425°F (215°C). Line a large baking pan or 9x13-inch (23x33cm) baking pan with foil, set a baking rack in the pan, and coat the baking rack with nonstick cooking spray. 3. Place the thighs on the rack skin side down. Bake, uncovered. for 30 minutes. Turn over the thighs and continue to bake for 20 to 25 minutes, until cooked through. The internal temperature should be at least 165°F (75°C). When cutting into the chicken near the thickest section, all of the juices should run clear. While the chicken is baking we can prepare the sauce. Prepare the Sauce 4. In a large skillet over medium-low heat, melt the butter. When the butter is melted, add the honey, lemon slices, garlic, lemon juice, soy sauce, and 1 tablespoon water. Bring the sauce to a simmer, then cook, periodically stirring the sauce until it thickens, about 5 minutes. 5. When the chicken is done, brush the sauce all over both sides and bake for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has browned and turned sticky. Allow the thighs to cool for 3 to 5 minutes, then enjoy! #royaleeats

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. Chicken alfredo tacos 🌮  For the chicken 1 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tsp smoked paprika powder  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  1/2 tsp Italian seasoning  2 tbsp lemon juice  2 tbsp oil for marinating + more for cooking For the Alfredo sauce: 2 tbsp butter 1 tbsp all purpose flour  2 cloves fresh garlic, minced  1 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream Salt to taste  1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 cup milk 3/4 cup Parmesan cheese, freshly grated  To assemble  15-16 mini tacos 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for lightly frying the tacos 1/4 cup parsley, freshly chopped for garnish  Method  Marinate the chicken with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, Italian seasoning, lemon juice, and oil for 20–30 minutes. Cook until golden and set aside. In the same pan, melt the butter and sauté the garlic. Whisk in the flour, then add the heavy cream and milk. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Simmer until slightly thickened, then stir in the Parmesan until smooth.  Add the cooked chicken to half of the sauce and toss to coat. Reserve half for later . Fill each tortilla with mozzarella, the chicken Alfredo mixture, and a little more mozzarella. Fold and pan-fry until golden and crispy on both sides. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with extra Alfredo sauce for dipping. #recipe #tacos #alfredochicken

Steak Cheese and Rice is easy to make and never disappoints! 🌮 INGREDIENTS  1 1/2 lbs Sirloin or New York Strip steak, sliced thin  1/2 tsp each salt and pepper 1 tsp each cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder 2 tsp chili powder 2 cups Jasmine rice rinsed  2 tbsp olive oil divided  1 small onion chopped 3 cups chicken broth 1 tbsp tomato Bouillon  1 1/2 cups White Queso 1 tbsp Fresh Cilantro 1 package Fajita size flour tortillas INSTRUCTIONS  Slice 1 1/2 lbs of steak into thin pieces. Add your sliced steak to a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil. Season with salt, pepper, cumin, dried cilantro, garlic powder, onion powder, and chili powder. Stir until steak is well coated in seasoning and oil. Set aside.   Rinse 2 cups of Jasmine rice. Add rice to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add 1 tbsp of olive oil and stir the rice around the skillet letting it toast up for 4-5 minutes.  Add the chopped onion and tomato bouillon to the skillet. Stir well. Add 3 cups of chicken broth. Stir well and let cook until it starts bubbling.  Once the whole skillet is bubbling, cover with a lid, lower the heat to medium low, and let cook for about 18 minutes or until rice is tender.   While the rice is cooking, heat a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the steak until it is cooked to your liking. I cooked the steak for about 10 minutes. Remove it from the heat.  Top the cooked rice with the steak and pour white queso over the skillet of steak and rice. Top with fresh cilantro. Serve as is or inside of flour tortillas.  #easyrecipes #dinner #steak

videos.caption: Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Quick and easy cinnamon roll bites 😮‍💨😋 Ingredients: Pillsbury Grands biscuits  ⅓ cup unsalted butter, melted ⅓ cup granulated sugar ½ tablespoon ground cinnamon 1½ cups powdered sugar ⅓ cup heavy whipping cream ½ tablespoon vanilla bean paste or extract Instructions: Preheat the oven to 350°F. Using a 16.3-ounce can of Pillsbury Grands biscuits, cut each biscuit into quarters and gently roll each piece into a ball. Transfer the biscuit pieces to a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and cinnamon sugar, then gently toss until each piece is evenly coated. Lightly spray a 9x9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray or coat it with a thin layer of butter. Transfer the coated biscuit pieces to the baking dish and spread them out evenly. Bake at 350°F for 25–28 minutes, or until golden brown and cooked through. While the cinnamon roll bites are baking, prepare the icing. In a bowl, whisk together 1½ cups of powdered sugar, ⅓ cup of heavy whipping cream, and about ½ tablespoon of vanilla bean paste or vanilla extract. For a thicker icing, add more powdered sugar. For a thinner consistency, add a little more heavy whipping cream. Let the cinnamon roll bites cool for about 5 minutes before drizzling or spreading the icing over the top. I hope you enjoy this simple and delicious recipe and follow for more! #fyp #BakeWithMe #sweettooth #cinnamonroll #viralvideo

Fruity Pebble Ice Cream Taco #shorts #food #recipe Full Recipe 👇🏿 Fruity Pebbles Choco Tacos Yield: 6–8 tacos TOOLS NEEDED Mixing bowls Fine mesh strainer Electric hand mixer Rubber spatula Waffle cone maker Taco shell holder Pastry brush Microwave-safe bowl Ice cream scoop or piping bag --- BEFORE YOU START - Keep the heavy cream very cold and stop whipping just under stiff peaks so the ice cream stays light and creamy. - Shape the waffle taco shells immediately while they are still hot. Once they cool, they will crack instead of bending. - Let the taco shells cool completely before adding the white chocolate, and keep them upright in a taco holder anytime they are setting or freezing. --- FRUITY PEBBLES ICE CREAM Ingredients 2 cups cold heavy whipping cream, divided 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles cereal, for soaking 3/4 cup sweetened condensed milk 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, finely chopped 2 tablespoons caramel sauce Instructions 1. Add 1 1/2 cups Fruity Pebbles to a bowl and pour about 1 1/2 cups of the heavy cream over the cereal. 2. Cover and refrigerate for 2–3 hours. 3. Pour the cereal and cream through a fine mesh strainer into a clean bowl. 4. Press down firmly on the soaked cereal with the back of a spoon or spatula to get as much of the Fruity Pebbles cream out as possible. 5. Discard the soaked cereal. 6. Add enough fresh cold heavy cream to the strained cream to bring it back up to about 2 cups total. 7. Whip the cream until it reaches just under stiff peaks. It should be thick and fluffy but still smooth. 8. Gently fold in the sweetened condensed milk. 9. Finely chop or crush 1/2 cup Fruity Pebbles. 10. Mix the cereal with the caramel sauce. 11. Fold the caramel Fruity Pebbles mixture into the ice cream. 12. Transfer to a freezer-safe container, cover, and freeze for 4–6 hours or until firm enough to scoop. --- WAFFLE TACO SHELLS Ingredients Prepared homemade waffle cone batter Instructions 1. Preheat your waffle cone maker. 2. Add enough batter to make a thin, even waffle and cook until golden brown. 3. As soon as it comes off the waffle cone maker, carefully fold it into a taco shape. 4. Place it in a taco shell holder or taco mold while it cools. 5. Repeat with the remaining batter and let all of the shells cool completely. --- WHITE CHOCOLATE COATING Ingredients 2 cups chopped white chocolate 1–2 tablespoons coconut oil Instructions 1. Add the chopped white chocolate and 1 tablespoon coconut oil to a microwave-safe bowl. 2. Microwave in short intervals, stirring between each one, until completely melted and smooth. 3. Add a little more coconut oil if needed to loosen the chocolate. 4. Brush a thin layer of white chocolate all over the inside of each taco shell, making sure to get down into the bottom curve. 5. Place the shells upright in a taco holder and freeze for about 10 minutes, or until the chocolate is firm. --- ASSEMBLY Ingredients Prepared Fruity Pebbles ice cream Prepared white chocolate-coated taco shells Remaining melted white chocolate 1 cup Fruity Pebbles cereal, crushed Instructions 1. Remove the ice cream from the freezer. If it is very firm, let it soften for a few minutes until it is easy to scoop. 2. Fill each taco shell with the Fruity Pebbles ice cream. 3. Press the ice cream gently into the center and sides so the taco is completely filled. 4. Smooth the exposed ice cream across the top. 5. Place the tacos upright in the taco holder and freeze until the ice cream is firm again, about 30–60 minutes. 6. Reheat the remaining white chocolate if needed. 7. Dip the exposed edge of each taco into the white chocolate, rotating from the top toward the bottom in a curved motion so the chocolate follows the shape of the taco. 8. Immediately sprinkle crushed Fruity Pebbles over the wet chocolate. 9. Return the tacos to the freezer until the chocolate is set and the ice cream is completely firm. 10. Keep frozen until ready to serve.

Complete dinner in under 30 minutes✨ One pot, simple ingredients, minimal cleanup, and a dinner everyone actually gets excited about. Juicy chicken thighs, cozy penne pasta, and the freshest, creamiest side salad. These are the kinds of meals that end up on repeat in my kitchen because they’re easy, comforting, and just so good🥰 Ingredients 🐓🍝🥗 One pot chicken & pasta 1½ pounds boneless skinless chicken thighs/breast 1 onion, sliced ¼ cup olive oil 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon paprika 1 teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon black pepper 1 package 16 oz penne pasta  4 cups chicken broth or any broth you love ½ cup tomato paste Side salad 🥒🍅🥑 4 Persian cucumbers, chopped About a cup of cherry tomatoes  1 shallot  1 avocado  Olive oil Fresh lemon juice  Fresh lime juice  Salt and pepper Instructions Place the chicken thighs in a bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. One pot, one fresh salad, and a full comforting dinner on the table in under 30 minutes💛 #sivanskitchen #easyrecipes #onepotmeal #dinnerideas #quickmeals

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Enjoy! #dinner #easyrecipe #homecooking #tiktokrecipe #fyp #shawarma #chickenrecipe #cookingathometiktoktv

Crispy garlic parmesan chicken rolls Ingredients  For the chicken: 2 lb boneless chicken breast, cut into small pieces  Salt to taste 1 tsp black pepper  1 tbsp garlic powder  1 tsp onion powder  2 tsp paprika powder  1/2 tsp cumin powder  1 tbsp lemon juice  1 tbsp oil (for marinating) 1 small yellow onion, diced 1 red bell pepper, diced 2 tbsp oil for cooking  For the garlic parmesan sauce: 1 tbsp butter  1 tbsp garlic, minced  1 1/2 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream 1 tbsp cream cheese  Salt to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper  1 tsp garlic powder  1 tsp red chili flakes  1 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tsp parsley , finely chopped  To assemble: 9-10 small flour tortilla wraps 1 cup mozzarella cheese  Oil for pan frying  Method: Season chicken with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, cumin, lemon juice, and oil. Mix well. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken until fully cooked and lightly golden. Add diced onion and bell pepper and sauté for 2–3 minutes until softened. Set aside. For the sauce, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add garlic and sauté for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and red chili flakes. Whisk until smooth and simmer until slightly thickened. Lower the heat and stir in Parmesan until melted and smooth. Turn off the heat and add parsley. Reserve half the sauce for dipping and mix the remaining half with the chicken. Let cool slightly. Add a few spoonfuls of filling to each tortilla and sprinkle with mozzarella. Fold in the sides and roll tightly. Lightly oil a skillet over medium to medium-low heat. Place rolls seam-side down and cook, turning until golden and crispy on all sides. Add more oil as needed. Avoid high heat so the tortilla doesn't brown before the cheese melts. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and Parmesan and serve immediately with the reserved garlic Parmesan dipping sauce. #recipe #garlicparmesan #chickenrolls

Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken & Rice Bake A delicious one-pan dinner featuring juicy chicken coated in a sweet, sticky honey garlic glaze, baked over fluffy seasoned rice with carrots and topped with green onions. 55–65 minutes Ingredients For the chicken: 1½ lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs or breasts ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tbsp olive oil For the honey garlic sauce: ⅓ cup honey ¼ cup soy sauce 4 garlic cloves, minced 2 tbsp ketchup 1 tbsp rice vinegar 1 tsp grated ginger 1 tbsp cornstarch mixed with 2 tbsp water For the rice: 1½ cups uncooked long-grain white rice 2¼ cups chicken broth 1 medium carrot, diced ½ cup chopped onion 1 tbsp butter ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 2 green onions, chopped (garnish) Instructions 1. Preheat oven: Set your oven to 375°F (190°C). 2. Season chicken: Toss chicken with salt, pepper, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. 3. Prepare rice: Spread uncooked rice in a greased baking dish. Add carrots, onions, butter, chicken broth, salt, and pepper. Stir together. 4. Prepare sauce: In a saucepan, combine honey, soy sauce, garlic, ketchup, vinegar, and ginger. Simmer for 2 minutes. Stir in cornstarch slurry and cook until slightly thickened. 5. Assemble: Place seasoned chicken over the rice and brush generously with honey garlic sauce, reserving some sauce for serving. 6. Bake: Cover tightly with foil and bake for 35–40 minutes. Remove foil and bake another 10–15 minutes, until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches 165°F internally. 7. Finish: Brush with reserved sauce (reheat it first if it touched raw chicken). Broil for 2–3 minutes until golden and sticky, watching carefully. 8. Serve: Sprinkle with chopped green onions and serve hot. Tip: If the rice needs more time, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking. For a glossy restaurant-style finish, brush the chicken with extra honey garlic glaze just before serving. This is a homemade version inspired by the dish shown, rather than the creator's confirmed recipe. Similar chicken-and-rice bakes use a covered-then-uncovered baking method.  #HoneyGarlicChicken ##HoneyGarlicChickeny#ChickenAndRice#EasyDinnerRecipesghts ##foodseasytomake

Honey chipotle chicken wraps! 🌯 #Hungry #Lunch  What you need for the salad 🥗  2 red onions  2 Bell peppers 🫑  1 cucumber  1 Iceberg lettuce  Dice and put these in a bowl 🥣  For the chicken 🍗  2kg boneless chicken thighs, cut into small cubes  1 tsp Tandoori spice blend  1 tbsp Italian Aromat all purpose seasoning  1 tbsp smoked paprika 2 tbsp Dark soy sauce  1 tbsp chili powder 1 tsp garlic granules  2 red onion, diced Mix these up and leave for 30 minutes so it marinates, ideally should be 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour.  What you need for the Honey chipotle sauce 🥣 4 tbsp of fat free Greek yoghurt (my preference) or 8tbsp Mayonnaise  1/2 tbsp of honey 🍯  2 tbsp of ketchup  1 tbsp of peanut butter 🥜 (my preference) 1/2 tbsp of chilli powder  1 squeezed lemon juice 🍋 30g of Chopped flat free Parsley 🌿  Give these a mix!  How to cook! 👨🏾‍🍳🫕 Firstly, season your diced chicken and leave in the refrigerator for 30min so it marinates. ideally they should be left for 1hr30min for the best balance of flavour 🙂 While waiting it’s should be the best time to make the honey chipotle sauce. 🧠😉 (recipe above, pls go back if you’ve missed it 🙂) Dice all you need for your salad options and leave in a bowl 🥗🥣  Get your frying pan out, using olive oil, cook your chicken for 5-7 minutes per sides at 165°C–175°C When the chicken’s cooked add a little portion of your honey chipotle sauce and mix  For dressing your tortilla 🫓 Place on your tortilla, your creamed up diced chicken, salad, lettuce (to prevent your sauce from dripping), Mozzarella cheese and some sauce on top to go with.  Fold nicely and Toast on fire in a low heat to avoid your warp getting burnt.  Voilaaaa! You just made a honey chipotle chicken wrap 🌯😉

Hot Honey Chicken Tenders 🍯🔥  For all of you asking about the app I made (it’s free!!) you can search “osta” on the App Store or Google Play 😁 A little sweet, a little spicy and majorly crispy… served with buttermilk ranch.  For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. Slice the chicken breasts into strips about 1 inch thick. Add to a mixing bowl with buttmilk, pickle juice, & chicken seasonings. Mix together. Cover & refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or overnight for extra tender chicken. 2. In a bowl, combine the flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and flour mixture seasonings. Mix. 3. Add neutral oil to a large pot until it is about 2–3 inches deep. Heat the oil to 350°F / 175°C. Keep the oil around this temp at all times.  4. Drizzle a little buttermilk marinade into the flour mixture & stir to create flaky bits. Shake excess marinade off the chicken, coat each piece in the flour mixture. Shake off extra flour & place into the oil. 5. Don’t touch them for the first 1–2 mins. Fry for 7–8 mins, or until golden brown and cooked through. Transfer to wire rack.  6. Meanwhile, melt butter over medium-low heat. Add honey and 2–3 tbsp hot sauce and whisk until smooth.  7. Mix the ranch ingredients in a bowl.  8. Toss or brush the tenders with the hot honey sauce. Serve with buttermilk ranch & enjoy! #cookingathometiktoktv #recipe #recipesoftiktok #easydinner

This One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi is creamy, cheesy, packed with flavor, and SO easy 😍 Everything cooks in one pan, including the gnocchi, so you get the creamiest sauce with barely any cleanup. Save this one for your next easy weeknight dinner! One Pot Marry Me Chicken Gnocchi Recipe  Ingredients: 2 boneless, skinless chicken breasts, diced 2 tbsp olive oil 1 tbsp minced garlic Italian seasoning Paprika Salt Pepper Onion powder Garlic powder 1 cup chicken broth 1 cup heavy cream ½ cup sun dried tomatoes, chopped 1 lb potato gnocchi ½ cup freshly grated Parmesan 2 cups fresh spinach Crushed red pepper flakes Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add diced chicken and season with Italian seasoning, paprika, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Cook until browned and cooked through. Add minced garlic and cook for about 30 seconds. Add chicken broth, heavy cream, sun dried tomatoes and crushed red pepper flakes. Season the sauce with Italian seasoning, salt, pepper, onion powder and garlic powder. Stir to combine. Add the uncooked gnocchi directly to the pan. Bring to a gentle simmer and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the gnocchi is tender and the sauce has thickened. Stir in freshly grated Parmesan until melted and creamy. Add spinach and stir until wilted. #marrymechicken #onepotmeal #easydinner #dinnerrecipe #weeknightdinner

LOADED BUFFALO CHICKEN POTATOES 🍟  These were so delicious and easy to make! Perfect for a high protein lunch or dinner option. Save for later☝🏼 •546 kcals  •44g PRO, 65g CHO, 18g FAT For 1 serving: -250g of potato -2 tsp of aromat seasoning  -1 tsp of olive oil or use low cal spray -1 tsp of paprika -1 tsp of garlic granules -Salt/pepper -100g of uncooked chicken breast -15g of light mozzarella/cheddar -1 tbsp of light ranch (mixed with 1 tbsp of water) -Fresh parsley, chopped Buffalo sauce: -2 tbsp of Franks Red Hot Buffalo Sauce -1 tbsp of light ranch -15g of light cream cheese  Method: 1. Wash the potatoes then slice into cubes. Par boil for 5 minutes then drain. Season with aromat seasoning. Spray with oil, toss and air fry or cook in the oven at 200°C for 20-25 minutes. 2. Season the chicken with 1 tsp of paprika, garlic granules, salt and pepper.  3. Air fry at 180°C for 15-20 minutes. 4. Once cooked, add to a bowl and shred apart with two forks. 5. Whisk together the buffalo sauce, ranch and cream cheese. Then add the chicken and shred apart.  6. Add the cooked potatoes to an oven safe dish and top with the buffalo chicken. Sprinkle over the mozzarella/cheddar and place under the grill for 5 minutes or until the cheese has melted. 7. Remove from the grill. Mix together 1 tbsp of ranch with 1 tbsp of water and drizzle over the fries. Sprinkle over fresh parsley. Enjoy! #loadedfries #buffalofries #buffalochicken #cheesy #highproteinrecipes

Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

Hot rice, spicy chicken, loads of garlic and chilli, Holy basil, then a crispy fried egg on top. Simple food, but when it’s done properly it’s honestly one of my favourite things to eat. This is my version at home. And before the Pad Kra Pao police come for me, I’m joking when I say it’s exactly like Thailand 😂 I just make it the way I like eating it salty, spicy, a little bit sweet, heaps of basil and enough sauce to get all through the rice. If you’re Thai or you make Pad Kra Pao better than me, tell me what I should change. I actually want to know.

garlic parmesan chicken wraps 🧄✨ Ingredients  Chicken - 1.5 lb boneless skinless chicken breast  - 1 1/2 tsp garlic powder  - 1 tsp onion powder  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp smoked paprika  - 1 tsp basil - 1/2 tsp Kinder’s buttery garlic seasoning  - Salt and pepper to taste  - 1 tbsp avocado oil (for cooking) - 1 tbsp unsalted butter (for cooking) Garlic Parmesan sauce - 2 tbsp unsalted butter  - 1 1/4 cup heavy cream  - 1 shallot, finely chopped  - 6 garlic cloves, minced - 2/3 cup Parmesan cheese, shredded  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 tsp roasted garlic powder  - 1 tsp oregano  - 1 tsp red chili flakes  - Salt and pepper to taste  Garlic Parmesan fries  - Fried French fries  - 1/4 cup Parmesan cheese  - 1 tbsp unsalted butter, melted  - 1 tbsp freshly chopped parsley  - 1 tsp garlic powder  - Salt to taste  Assembly  - Medium flour tortillas - Chopped romaine lettuce Instructions - In a large bowl, season chicken breasts with all seasonings and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix until evenly coated. - Heat avocado oil and butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Sear chicken on both sides until golden and cooked through (165°F internal temperature). Let rest, then slice into strips. - In the same skillet, melt butter over medium heat. Add chopped shallot and sauté until softened. Stir in minced garlic and cook until fragrant. -  Add roasted garlic powder, oregano, red pepper flakes, salt, and pepper. Stir well and cook until fragrant. - Pour in heavy cream stir well and simmer until slightly thickened. - Add shredded Parmesan and chopped parsley, stirring until the cheese melts and the sauce is smooth. Return sliced chicken to the skillet and toss until well coated. - In a large bowl, toss hot, crispy fries with melted butter, Parmesan, garlic powder, chopped parsley, and salt until evenly coated. - Add chopped romaine, garlic Parmesan chicken, and seasoned fries to medium tortillas. Fold tightly and toast in a skillet over medium heat until golden and crispy on both sides. • • • #recipes #dinnerideas #chickenrecipes #food #recipeideas

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. NVIDIA CEO Jensen Huang introduces 4 tiny Microduck robots during the NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 keynote, demonstrating the future of physical artificial intelligence and robotics. Watch these miniature walking robots perform somersaults, follow commands, and even make unexpected mistakes during a memorable live demonstration. During the October 21, 2026 keynote in Berlin, Germany, Jensen Huang showcased Microduck robots developed through a collaboration involving Pollen Robotics and Hugging Face. Standing approximately 10 inches tall, these small bipedal robots demonstrate how artificial intelligence can be used to train machines to walk, balance, and perform complex physical movements. One of the highlights came when Huang asked the 4 robots to take a nap. While 3 immediately toppled over, the fourth needed additional prompting. Another Microduck even faced the wrong direction, adding some unexpected humor to the demonstration. Behind these entertaining moments is advanced robotics technology powered by NVIDIA's artificial intelligence ecosystem. Using NVIDIA Isaac Sim, Isaac Lab, and the Newton physics engine, developers can train virtual robots through thousands of simulated experiences before transferring learned behaviors to physical machines. The demonstration also highlighted NVIDIA RTX Spark and the growing importance of simulation-based learning, humanoid robotics, intelligent automation, and physical artificial intelligence. NVIDIA GTC Berlin 2026 provided a glimpse into how artificial intelligence is moving beyond digital applications and into robots that can interact with the real world.

 all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Grill (best option) or pan sear until lightly charred — don’t overcook, it will finish in the oven. 🥔 Potatoes Blanch potatoes of choice, drizzle with olive oil + seasoning, and roast at 400° while grilling the chicken and preparing the sauce. 🥣 Creamy Yogurt Herb Sauce • 2 cups @arzdairy yogurt • ½ cup @arzdairy Ayran yogurt drink • 4 cloves garlic • 2 tbsp chopped parsley • 2 tbsp fresh cilantro • 1 tbsp cornstarch • 1 cup chicken stock • 1 cup chicken broth • 2 cups heavy cream • Juice of 1 lemon • 1 tsp Vegeta • Salt & pepper to taste Layer grilled chicken between the potatoes, pour the sauce generously over the top, and bake for about 15 minutes until perfectly tender and creamy. I’ve been seeing this chicken au poivre everywhere and wanted to try it.  Recipies below ⬇️ Bread Recipe: •4 cups bread flour (500g) •1½ cups + 1 tbsp warm water (375g) •2¼ tsp instant yeast (7g) @fleischmannsyeast  •1¾ tsp salt (10g) •2 tsp honey (10g) Mix water, honey, yeast, flour, and salt until just combined and sticky. Cover and rise 1½–2 hrs, doing 3–4 folds every 30 min. Divide into 3, shape, and proof 30–45 min. Score and bake at 475°F with steam for 10 min. Reduce to 450°F and bake 12–18 min until deeply golden. Cool 30 min before slicing. Chicken Au Poivre: •8 chicken thighs (bone-in + skin on)  seasonings: chicken soup blend, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper. •3 tbsp unsalted butter  •1 shallot  •3 garlic cloves  •1/4 cup light brandy  •1 cup chicken stock  •2 cups heavy whipping cream  •2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper  •1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary  •1 tbsp dijon mustard  •1 tbsp worcestershire sauce  •salt to taste  Sear chicken skin side down first for 25 minutes on low heat until golden, then flip and allow to cook another 10 minutes. Set chicken aside, add in butter, shallots and cook down for 1-2 minutes. Then add in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Deglaze with brandy, and add in chicken stock, HWC, pepper, rosemary, Dijon, Worcestershire, and salt. Throw chicken + juices back in and allow to simmer on low for 25-30 mins.  Cheesy potato puree gratin: •8-10 medium Yukon gold potatoes  •1 stick of butter  •3 garlic cloves  •fresh rosemary + thyme  •2 cups milk  •white pepper  •grated nutmeg  •Parmesan cheese + mozzarella. Boil potatoes in heavily salted water until super tender. Melt butter in a sauce pan, cook garlic for 30 seconds, add in rosemary and thyme and cook for another 30 seconds, then add in milk, white pepper, and grated nutmeg, and salt to taste. Mix in riced potatoes with milk, and cheeses. Throw potatoes into a baking dish and broil until the top is golden.  Brussel sprouts seasoned with garlic butter herb seasoning + olive oil and baked at 450 for 20-25 mins .  Creme brûlée: •2 cups heavy cream  •1 vanilla bean (extract or paste work too) •6 egg yolks @Happy Egg  •1/2 cup sugar  •pinch of salt  Heat the heavy cream + vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and salt. Slowly whisk in the hot cream to temper eggs then add in the rest. Pour into ramekins. Place in a water bath and bake at 325°F until set with a slight jiggle (40-60 mins varying by oven). Cool and refrigerate. Sprinkle sugar on top and torch until golden and crisp.  #chickenaupoivre #mashedpotatoes #cheesypotatopureegratin #homemadebread #cremebrulee

Cut chicken into bite sized pieces 2. Hugging Face and its Pollen Robotics subsidiary have opened preorders for Microduck, a $399 desktop-sized robot built for experimenting with “physical AI.”  The 25cm robot contains 15 motors, a camera, a depth sensor, two inertial measurement units, and a “beak” that can grasp small objects.  Its open-source software allows developers to train behaviors through reinforcement learning in a physics simulator before transferring them to the real machine.  Microduck can already walk, crouch, follow a laser, grab objects, and recover from many falls.  More than 10,000 units were preordered in its first five days, roughly $4 million! Initial deliveries are targeted before Christmas of this year in North America, Europe, and the UK. Would you buy one?

Cheesy Broccoli, Chicken, and Rice Skillet is super easy to make and can be on the table in 30 minutes!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breast 2 tbsp butter  1 onion, chopped  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, and paprika  1 tbsp ranch seasoning  1 tbsp minced garlic 2 cups of chicken broth  1 cup jasmine rice, rinsed  2 cups chopped broccoli  1 1/2 cups shredded Colby Jack cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken into small pieces. Roughly chop broccoli into smaller pieces (just be careful not to chop too small or it will completely fall apart while cooking).  Add butter to a skillet over medium-high heat. Add the chicken and onions and spread them out evenly in pan. Season with salt, pepper, paprika, and ranch seasoning.  Once chicken is almost cooked through add minced garlic. Add the rinsed rice, broccoli, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil, reduce heat to medium-low, and cover with a lid.  Let cook covered for about 18 minutes or until rice is cooked. Add about a cup of shredded cheddar cheese and stir. Top with more cheese and cover with the lid to let the cheese melt or pop it in the oven under the broiler for just a few minutes. Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out! #easyrecipes #dinner #mealideas

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Welcome to Episode 02 of Agent Wars. Today we’re challenging 5 top AI models to design, engineer and 3D print a bridge with the goal of holding the most possible weight. For Episode 02, here are the models I tested, with their reasoning level and the harness I used for each:  🇺🇸 Anthropic: Claude Opus 5.5 (High) 🇨🇳 Kimi: Kimi K3 (High) 🇺🇸 Meta: Muse Spark 1.3 (High) 🇺🇸 OpenAI: GPT 6 Astra (High) 🇺🇸 SpaceXAI: Grok 4.7 (High) Each bridge had specific parameters. It had to span 2 feet, use a maximum 500 grams of filament, and it had to be under 18 hours of printing time. We specified what type of weight and where we would place it on the bridge. 🏆 THE SCORE: Claude Opus 5.5 held an estimated 130 lbs! It took 9 hours and 11 minutes to print 17 parts and used 441 grams of filament.  Meta Muse Spark 1.3 held 26.5 lbs.  It took 13 hours and 12 minutes to print 49 parts and used 478 grams of filament.  OpenAI GPT-6 Astra held an estimated 17.5 lbs.  It took 15 hours and 44 minutes to print 29 parts and used 442 grams of filament.  SpaceXAI Grok 4.7 did not finish. On assembly it could not stand up by itself.  It took 12 hours and 22 minutes to print 29 parts and used 460 grams of filament.  Kimi K3 did not finish. It wasn’t engineered correctly so the bridge could not even be assembled.  It took 11 hours and 19 minutes to print 35 parts and used 446 grams of filament.  🏅 That means our champion for this episode is Claude Opus 5.5. Not only did it hold the most weight (by FAR) it also took the least time to print, used the least amount of parts and used the least amount of filament. #agentwars #ai #rpn #claude

Sticky Chicken & Rice!✨🍚#homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #budgetrecipes #DinnerIdeas  Recipe:  Chicken: * 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cubed * 1 tsp each onion powder, garlic powder & salt * ½ tsp each black pepper & paprika * 2 tbsp olive oil * ⅓ cup cornstarch * Olive oil for cooking Sticky Sauce: * ½ cup soy sauce * ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey * 1 tbsp hoisin sauce * 1 tbsp ketchup * 1 tsp ginger paste * ½ tbsp minced garlic * 1½ tbsp cornstarch * 2 tbsp butter For serving: White rice, green onions & sesame seeds Instructions 1. Season chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, paprika and olive oil. Toss with cornstarch until evenly coated. 2. Whisk together all sauce ingredients except the butter until smooth. 3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Cook chicken in batches until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. 4. Reduce heat and melt butter in the same skillet, scraping up the browned bits. 5. Pour in the sauce and stir until thickened. Add chicken back in and toss until coated in that sticky, glossy sauce. 6. Serve over white rice and top with green onions and sesame seeds. Enjoy!

Remove the chicken from the pan. In the same pan, add butter and one melted, add garlic. Sauté for a minute and then add in flour and sauté an additional minute. Stir until the cheese is fully melted then add the chicken back to the pan. Cover with the lid and simmer for five minutes. Spoon the sauce over the chicken. Crack Chicken Bake 🐔🧀🥓🍲🔥 RECIPE ⬇️ Ingredients: Chicken Breast Cream Cheese Sour Cream Jalapeños  Bacon Colby Jack Cheese Seasonings: Paprika Seasoned Salt Black Pepper Garlic Powder Ranch Seasoning Onion Powder Instructions: Preheat your oven to 350°F. Cut your chicken into bite-sized pieces and add them to a 7x11 baking dish. Season the chicken with onion powder, garlic powder, black pepper, seasoned salt, and paprika. Mix well to ensure everything is evenly coated. In a separate bowl, add one block of softened cream cheese and season with garlic powder and pepper. Add a spoonful of sour cream, one diced jalapeño, 3 pieces of crumbled bacon, a handful of Colby Jack cheese, and one packet of ranch seasoning. Mix until well combined. Spread the mixture evenly over the chicken. Top with additional cheese and bacon. Bake for 45 minutes, or until the chicken is fully cooked and the top is hot and bubbly. High Protein Honey Garlic Butter Chicken Mac n Cheese! Only 597 Calories!🍯🧄🍗 Made By: @Jalalsamfit  For All The Best & Simple High Protein Recipes In One Place Follow: @legends_cooking Follow My Main Account: @Mykhaylo  Macros: 597 Calories 59g Protein 52g Carbs 16g Fat Ingredients & Cooking Directions: Make 4 Servings Honey Garlic Chicken: 800g Raw Chicken Breast cut into cubes 1.5 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (leave it out if you don’t want it spicy) 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder 1.5 Tsp Onion Powder 1.5 Tep Paprika or Smoked Paprika 2 Tsp Olive Oil 30g Light Butter, for cooking + extra once cooked 2 Tsp Minced Garlic 30g Honey (15g Honey per batch of chicken) Handful Fresh Chopped Parsley Get a pan on medium heat first then add butter. Let it melt then add your chicken (don’t overcrowd the pan). Cook for 4-5 mins on one side first till you get a nice golden brown crust. Then cook the other side for 3-4 mins more. Lower the heat completely when adding the extra butter, garlic and honey. Mix till well coated and sticky then set aside. Garlic Mac n Cheese: Big Tbsp Minced Garlic 300ml Skimmed Milk 160g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) 1 Tsp Salt or to taste 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika 1/2 Tsp Nutmeg (adds a great deep flavour!) 100g Low Fat Cheddar Cheese (You can use any low fat cheese you have available) 220g (Uncooked weight) Macaroni Pasta or any pasta of your choice On medium low heat cook the minced garlic in the residue butter from the chicken for 2 mins till fragrant. Then add milk, cream cheese, spices. Mix this till completely smooth then lower the heat before adding the cheddar cheese. Stir till it melts then add your cooked macaroni and give it a good mix then. Enjoy! #legends_cooking #lowcalorie #highprotein #healthyeating #healthyfood

Puerto Rican pollo guisado 🇵🇷🥘🍗🌿 Dinner ready in 30 minutes ⏲️  Chicken marinade  Drums (3x) and thighs (4x) 1 tbsp complete seasoning with adobo  1 tbsp of garlic powder  1 tsp of oregano and cumin 1/2 tsp salt 2 tbsp of sofrito  1 sazon packet  Drizzle of olive oil  Marinate for 30 mins to an hour  Pollo guisado  Half an onion  Half a green and red bell pepper  3 garlic cloves  Half can of tomato sauce  2 bay leaves  1/2 tsp adobo  1 packet of sazon 1/2 tsp chicken bouillon  1 tbsp of sofrito  Olives  2 medium sized russet potatoes  Directions  Clean your chicken and add seasonings, sofrio and oil to chicken and let marinate for 30 mins to an hour. Before cooking chicken take out the fridge to allow it to get to room temperature. In a pan add oil and brown chicken on both sides then remove chicken.  Add your onion and bell peppers to the pan and cook for 2-3 minutes before adding garlic.  Add your sofrito, tomatoes sauce, seasonings and olive mixtung together. Allow to simmer until fragrant.  Add your chicken back to the pot with water enough to cover the chicken. Add the potatoes and your bay leaves and let cook for 20 minutes until your potatoes are fork tender.  Service with rice and enjoy ❤️ #polloguisado #chickenstew #puertoricanfood #dinnerideas #recetas

Vodka Sauce Baked Ziti 🍂🍝 Classic baked ziti is one that doesn’t need much convincing, but vodka sauce takes it in a whole new direction. This version is creamy, a little spicy, and extra saucy, with plenty of ricotta tucked throughout and lots of mozzarella and Parmesan on top that gets bubbly and golden in the oven. I decided to keep it vegetarian, but I think spicy Italian sausage would take this one over the top. Artist Casey Curran creates kinetic sculptures that combine mechanical systems with forms inspired by plants and natural structures. In this prototype, layers of delicate petals are connected so that a single mechanical action produces a rippling movement across the entire structure. Instead of every element moving independently, the motion travels through the sculpture like a wave. This type of movement is central to Curran’s practice. Using motors, wires, cranks and carefully engineered mechanisms, he creates artificial flowers and organisms that bloom, flutter and contract.  The machinery is artificial, but the movement feels strangely organic ,engineering becomes a way of imitating the rhythms of living systems. #art #artist #fashion #avantgarde #design

Garlic Butter Beef Linguine with Creamy Parmesan Cheddar Sauce 🥩🧄🧀🍝 This Garlic Butter Beef Linguine is creamy, cheesy, and packed with rich garlic butter flavor. Tender seasoned ground beef is tossed with linguine in a silky Parmesan cheddar sauce for an easy, comforting dinner everyone will love. Ingredients * 12 oz linguine * 1 lb lean ground beef * 1 tbsp olive oil * 3 tbsp butter * 4 cloves garlic, minced * 1 cup heavy cream * 1/2 cup beef broth * 1 cup shredded sharp cheddar cheese * 1/2 cup grated Parmesan cheese * 1 tsp Italian seasoning * 1/2 tsp crushed red pepper flakes (optional) * 1/2 tsp garlic powder * Salt and black pepper, to taste * 2 tbsp chopped fresh parsley Instructions 1. Cook the linguine according to the package directions until al dente. Reserve 1/2 cup of the pasta water, then drain. 2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add the ground beef and cook until browned, breaking it apart as it cooks. Drain excess grease if needed. 3. Add the butter and minced garlic. Cook for 30 seconds until fragrant. 4. Pour in the beef broth and heavy cream. Stir well and simmer for 3–4 minutes. 5. Add the cheddar cheese and Parmesan cheese, stirring until completely melted and smooth. 6. Season with Italian seasoning, garlic powder, crushed red pepper flakes, salt, and black pepper. 7. Add the cooked linguine to the skillet and toss until every strand is coated in the creamy sauce. Add a splash of reserved pasta water if needed. 8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve immediately. Serving Suggestions Serve with garlic bread, Caesar salad, roasted broccoli, or sautéed green beans. Storage Store leftovers in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days. Reheat gently with a splash of milk or cream. Time * Prep Time: 10 minutes * Cook Time: 20 minutes * Total Time: 30 minutes Servings: 4–6 Save this recipe and follow for more easy comfort food recipes! ❤️ #GarlicButterBeef #CreamyPasta #Linguine #GroundBeefRecipes #EasyDinner
